); }; /* ========================================================================== MAIN APP COMPONENT ========================================================================== */ export default function App() { const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('home'); const [zipImages, setZipImages] = useState([]); const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true); const [zipError, setZipError] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { async function loadAndUnzip() { try { setIsLoading(true); // GitHub Pages compatible path resolution const zipPath = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ? `${process.env.PUBLIC_URL}/jillu-curtains-images.zip` : './jillu-curtains-images.zip'; const response = await fetch(zipPath); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`ZIP file not found at ${zipPath}`); } const blob = await response.blob(); const zip = new JSZip(); const unzipped = await zip.loadAsync(blob); const imagePromises = []; unzipped.forEach((relativePath, file) => { if (!file.dir && !relativePath.startsWith('__MACOSX/') && relativePath.match(/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|gif)$/i)) { const promise = file.async('blob').then((fileBlob) => { const url = URL.createObjectURL(fileBlob); return { name: relativePath, url }; }); imagePromises.push(promise); } }); const images = await Promise.all(imagePromises); setZipImages(images); } catch (err) { console.error('Error unzipping images:', err); setZipError(err.message); } finally { setIsLoading(false); } } loadAndUnzip(); }, []); return (
